title_en: Colom wins Mississippi Senate race. And, White House warns Dems over future probes
title_zh: 科罗姆赢得密西西比州参议员竞选。白宫就未来的调查警告民主党人

paragraphs.en: Democrat Scott Colom has won the U.S. Senate seat from Mississippi , defeating Republican Sen. Cindy Hyde-Smith by just a few thousand votes. Colom will be the first Black Senator from the state in nearly 150 years . His win expands the Democratic majority in the new Congress to 55 seats. The Alaska race is still undecided.
paragraphs.zh: 民主党人斯科特·科洛姆（Scott Colom）赢得密西西比州联邦参议员席位，以仅数千票的优势击败共和党参议员辛迪·海德-史密斯（Cindy Hyde-Smith）。科洛姆将成为该州近150年来首位黑人参议员。他的胜选使民主党在新一届国会中的多数优势扩大至55席。阿拉斯加州的选情仍未决出结果。

paragraphs.en: The White House is warning Democrats that their planned investigations into administration officials could cross the line into "blatant criminality." White House Counsel Will Scharf said in a letter to Rep. Robert Garcia, who is expected to lead the House Oversight Committee next year, that the administration is monitoring "abusive and capricious threats" from Democrats. The letter concludes by saying that "the administration will not be extorted and will not be cowed by unlawful process, motivated by animus, pettiness, hatred or any other unlawful motive to intimidate, penalize or interfere with the lawful functioning of government." Garcia said Democrats will not be deterred by threats from the Department of Justice or Trump's lawyers.
paragraphs.zh: 白宫警告民主党人，其计划对政府官员展开的调查可能越界，构成“公然犯罪”。白宫法律顾问威尔·沙夫（Will Scharf）在致众议员罗伯特·加西亚（Robert Garcia）的信中表示，政府正在监控民主党人的“滥用职权且反复无常的威胁”。加西亚预计将于明年出任众议院监督委员会主席。信末写道：“政府不会遭到勒索，也不会被非法程序所吓倒——这些程序出于敌意、狭隘、仇恨或任何其他非法动机，意在恐吓、惩罚或干扰政府的合法运作。”加西亚表示，民主党人不会被司法部或特朗普律师的威胁所吓退。

paragraphs.en: Russia and Ukraine have agreed to a significant prisoner swap after two days of U.S.-mediated talks in Abu Dhabi. Trump's envoys Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff are now in Moscow today to meet with Russian President Vladimir Putin and attempt to make more headway to end the war in Ukraine.
paragraphs.zh: 俄罗斯与乌克兰在美国斡旋下于阿布扎比进行了为期两天的会谈，双方已同意进行大规模换俘。特朗普的特使贾里德·库什纳（Jared Kushner）和史蒂夫·威特科夫（Steve Witkoff）今天在莫斯科会见俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京，试图为结束乌克兰战争取得更多进展。

paragraphs.en: Abdul El-Sayed has made history as the first Muslim elected to the U.S. Senate. The 42-year-old progressive from Michigan is already calling for a new direction for his party and urging President Trump to collaborate on actionable solutions. El-Sayed said that voters have temporarily entrusted Democrats with power, but warns that they risk losing that trust if they don't act boldly. As the senator-elect comes into the new role, he is advocating for new Democratic leadership in Congress, an end to the war in Iran, the passage of "Medicare for All" and the abolishment of ICE. While he acknowledges the challenge Senate Democrats face with a majority that's a few seats shy of being filibuster-proof, he remains open to working with his new Republican colleagues. In conversation with Morning Edition 's Leila Fadel, El-Sayed reflects on the recent elections, the future of the Democratic Party and the need for impactful legislation in the upcoming years.
paragraphs.zh: 阿卜杜勒·埃尔-赛义德（Abdul El-Sayed）创造了历史，成为首位当选美国联邦参议员的穆斯林。这位42岁的密歇根州进步派人士已呼吁其政党开辟新方向，并敦促特朗普总统在切实可行的解决方案上开展合作。埃尔-赛义德表示，选民暂时将权力托付给民主党人，但他警告说，如果民主党不采取大胆行动，就可能失去这份信任。作为当选参议员，他正步入新角色，主张国会民主党领导层换新、结束对伊朗的战争、通过“全民医保”（Medicare for All）以及废除美国移民和海关执法局（ICE）。尽管他承认参议院民主党人面临挑战——其多数优势距足以终结“冗长辩论”还差几席——但他仍愿意与新的共和党同僚合作。在接受《晨间新闻》（Morning Edition）主持人莱拉·法德尔（Leila Fadel）采访时，埃尔-赛义德回顾了近期选举、民主党的未来以及未来几年需要通过有影响力的立法的必要性。

paragraphs.en: The average price for a new vehicle in the U.S. has hit a record high of $51,109, according to Kelley Blue Book. This figure is about $500 above the previous record set in December 2025. For years, car prices have remained high, primarily due to supply chain issues stemming from the pandemic. But there's some good news: While that new high sets a record, it only represents a 2.1% increase over the past year. This means the price is rising more slowly.
